summary: XAI Floating Rate & Alternative Income Trust filed an 8-K disclosing termination of its sub-advisory agreement with Octagon Credit Investors and entry into an interim sub-advisory agreement with Rockford Tower Asset Management, a newly formed King Street subsidiary. The special shareholder meeting to approve the new agreement was adjourned to August 6, 2026. Advisory fee remains 1.70% of Managed Assets; investment objective and policies unchanged. Watch for shareholder approval and further proxy solicitation results.
